summary: Mina Joshi and Ryan Caldwell of Axiom Labs contacted Aegis Cloud Security support about an $11,800 overcharge on the first invoice under their new three-year elastic seat contract. Marcus Williams confirmed two errors: seats were billed at the May peak (2,080, inflated by ~200 temporary hackathon accounts) instead of the contracted monthly average (~1,890), and the enterprise API tier was charged twice. He traced the cause to a billing profile not updated during the contract migration, likely the same migration issue seen with Comply v2 accounts, and will ask billing operations to audit all elastic-seat accounts. Marcus committed to voiding the invoice and issuing a corrected one within five business days, before Axiom's June 20 payment run. Ryan praised the platform but said billing keeps letting them down, and asked for self-service visibility into seat counts.
